[Core Charge] (Armed Machine/Mounted Warrior/Proximate/Astroblazer & Cost 3 or more)

◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Nexus with the same card name as this card, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, place one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

When revealed from the deck by your "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family Spirit effect, you can deploy this card without paying the cost.

[Grand Skill: 5] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send five cores from this Nexus to the Void) Summon a "Proximate"/"Astroblazer" & "Armed Machine" family card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

When your "Armed Machine"/"Mounted Warrior" family Spirits are exhausted by your effect, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.
